links.outcome: Accuracy and hallucination rate of clinical QA with vs without ontology/knowledge-graph grounding
links.effect: GraphRAG achieved 98% accuracy (59/60) vs ChatGPT-4 37% and DeepSeek-R1 52%; hallucination rate fell from ~63% and ~48% to 1.7%.
links.quote: While ChatGPT-4 achieved 37% accuracy and DeepSeek-R1 achieved 52%, the ontology-grounded approach achieved 98% accuracy (59/60 questions).

screen.reason: The study tests adding an ontology-grounded knowledge graph (GraphRAG retrieval grounding) to LLMs to mitigate hallucinations in clinical question answering compared to baseline LLMs without grounding.

primary.practice: retrieval grounding via ontology-grounded knowledge graph
